fuel_consumption.source_quote: Cash settlements from fuel derivatives for FY2008 = receipts of $30,740,000; non-cash MTM gains = $1,847,000. Fair value of fuel hedge agreements = $15,576,000 (asset) at March 31, 2008. Company filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy April 10, 2008 (Debtor-in-Possession).

instrument_type_details.notes: Crude oil call agreements, swap agreements, and Jet A crack spread swaps for fuel hedging. Fair value = $15,576,000 (asset) at March 31, 2008. FY2008: cash settlement receipts $30,740,000 (decrease to fuel expense); MTM gains $1,847,000. Company filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy April 10, 2008 (Debtor-in-Possession). All outstanding fuel hedge agreements terminated and settled in May 2008, yielding cash receipts of $23,409,000. These fuel hedges did not qualify for hedge accounting under SFAS 133.

throughput.source_quote: fuel expense of $446,791,000 for 182,793,000 gallons used and $343,082,000 for 161,616,000 gallons used, resulted in an average fuel expense of $2.45 and $2.12 [per gallon for FY2008 and FY2007]

warnings: Frontier Airlines Holdings filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy April 10, 2008.
